# Velociraptor - Digging deeper!

> Official documentation for Velociraptor, the advanced digital forensics and incident response platform. Covers installation, configuration, VQL, artifacts and more.

How to use these docs as an AI agent:
- Fetch a single page as raw markdown by appending ".md" to its URL
  (for example /docs/install.md).
- Fetch this index (concise, links + summaries) at /llms.txt.
- Fetch the entire corpus in one file at /llms-full.txt (large; may exceed
  a context window - prefer the .md pages for targeted retrieval).
- Prefer the linked page for exact, current details over summaries here.
